newsitem.title: USA: MetroGolf says group has 9.54 pct of shrs.
newsitem.headline: MetroGolf says group has 9.54 pct of shrs.

text.p: MetroGolf Inc said on Friday that it had learned that an investment group had acquire nearly 10 perent of its common stock and intended to continue buying up to 50 percent of the company's common stock.
MetroGolf said it had been notified of an April 24, 13D SEC filing stating that the John W. McCall Investment Group had acquired 9.54 percent of the company's common stock.

In the filing, the group said its intent was to continue buying shares until it owned at least 50 percent of the company's common stock and to "replace some or all of issuer's current management and directors," MetroGolf said, quoting the filing.
MetroGolf Inc develops and operates golf centers.
